# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "TaxReturn.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc" indicating the active document and application.
- **System Tray / Desktop Environment**: Top-left corner shows "Activities" and application icons (Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Flatpak, Help, Trash).
- **Window Controls**: Top-right corner contains minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Date and Time**: Displayed as "Oct 22 19:16" in the top-center of the window.
- **Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help.

## Toolbar

- **Formatting Toolbar**: Contains icons for:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
  - Clipboard operations (Cut, Copy, Paste)
  - Font formatting (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font Color, Background Color)
  - Alignment (Left, Center, Right, Justify)
  - Number formatting (Currency, Percentage, Decimal places)
  - Borders and cell styles
  - Functions (Sum, Average, etc.)
  - Chart and object insertion
  - Special characters (Omega symbol)
  - Linking and commenting
  - Grid and table formatting
  - Drawing tools (Pen, shapes)
  - Cell formatting (Font size dropdown, currently set to 11 pt)

## Status Bar

- **Selected Cell**: Displays "B4" indicating the currently selected cell.
- **Formula Bar**: Shows "f. Σ = 1200000" indicating the formula bar is active and the value in cell B4 is 1,200,000.
- **Document Information**: Displays "Average: $1,200,000; Sum: $1,200,000" at the bottom right.
- **Zoom Level**: Displays "100%" indicating the current zoom level.
- **Sheet Navigation**: Displays "Sheet 1 of 1" and "TaxReturn" indicating the current sheet name.

## Document Content

- **Document Title**: "Corporate Tax Return - 2024" centered in cell B3.
- **Revenues Section**:
  - **Product Sales**: $1,200,000 (cell B4)
  - **Service Revenue**: $450,000 (cell B5)
  - **Investment Income**: $50,000 (cell B6)
  - **Other Income**: $15,000 (cell B7)
  - **Total Revenue**: $1,715,000 (cell B8)
- **Expenses Section**:
  - **COGS**: $600,000 (cell B11)
  - **Salaries**: $400,000 (cell B12)
  - **Rent**: $120,000 (cell B13)
  - **Marketing**: $80,000 (cell B14)
  - **R&D**: $150,000 (cell B15)
  - **Depreciation**: $50,000 (cell B16)
  - **Travel**: $20,000 (cell B17)
  - **Utilities**: $30,000 (cell B18)
  - **Other Expenses**: $15,000 (cell B19)
  - **Total Expenses**: $1,465,000 (cell B20)
- **Tax Calculation Section**:
  - **Taxable Income**: 250000 (cell B22)
  - **Tax Rate**: 21.00% (cell B23)
  - **Tax Liability**: 52500 (cell B24)

## Sidebar

- **Sidebar Icons**: On the right side, there are icons for:
  - **Format Painter**: Copy formatting from one cell to another.
  - **Styles**: Access to cell and paragraph styles.
  - **Functions**: Access to function wizard.
  - **Chart**: Insert chart.
  - **Object**: Insert object.
  - **Formula**: Access to formula bar.
  - **Zoom**: Zoom level control.
  - **Sheet Navigation**: Sheet navigation controls.

## Additional UI Elements
